## gitshift ssh-keygen

🔑 Generate and manage SSH keys for Git platform accounts

### Synopsis

Generate SSH keys with proper parameters and manage them within gitshift.
This command handles:
- SSH key generation with custom parameters
- Proper file naming and storage in ~/.ssh
- SSH key permissions (600 for private, 644 for public)
- Known hosts management
- Integration with gitshift account system

The generated keys can be used with any Git platform:
- GitHub (github.com and GitHub Enterprise)
- GitLab (gitlab.com and self-hosted)

```
gitshift ssh-keygen [account-alias] [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  # Generate key for GitHub account
  gitshift ssh-keygen work-github

  # Generate key for GitLab account
  gitshift ssh-keygen work-gitlab

  # Generate key with custom email
  gitshift ssh-keygen myaccount --email user@company.com

  # Generate RSA key instead of Ed25519
  gitshift ssh-keygen myaccount --type rsa --bits 4096

  # Generate key and add to GitHub automatically
  gitshift ssh-keygen myaccount --add-to-github
```

### Options

```
      --add-to-github   Automatically add the public key to GitHub
      --bits int        Key size in bits (RSA: 2048/4096, ECDSA: 256/384/521)
      --email string    Email for SSH key comment
  -f, --force           Overwrite existing SSH key if present
  -h, --help            help for ssh-keygen
      --type string     SSH key type (ed25519, rsa, ecdsa) (default "ed25519")
```

### Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --config string   config file (default is $HOME/.config/gitshift/config.yaml)
```
